selection: Among 98304,196608,294912,393216 checkpoints with braking>=32/36 and terminal>=27/30 and zero retention envelope exits: maximize earlier distinct qualified anchors, then robust 3/3 anchors, then earlier contacts, then braking contacts, then latest endpoint. If none eligible use final checkpoint; no promotion. BC separately evaluated, never substituted for a PPO checkpoint.
go: B exceeds A earlier qualification at >=2 distinct anchors and gains >=1 robust anchor, with braking>=32/36 and terminal>=27/30 and no retention envelope exits. Demonstrated starts alone do not pass. Report final persistence and held-out independently.
stop: Full 393216 per arm; only numerical invalidity, invalid experiment, exhausted authorized resources or severe sustained collapse can stop early. No time deadline or zero-early-success futility gate.
